_comment: Which sites get SEO effort and which are hosted only. Not every live site is a ranking target: some belong to people who pay for hosting and nothing else, and spending effort on those is work nobody asked for. Confirmed with the owner 2026-09-21.

seo_target._note: Mitch's own properties. On-page, schema, content and link prospecting all apply here.
seo_target.crack-rx: Mitch's startup. getcrackrx.com — the product is his, not a client's.
seo_target.seacoast-hurricane-shutters: Converted to lead-gen 2026-09-21 — the original operator left the business. SEE THE BLOCKERS BELOW before treating it as a normal lead-gen page.

seacoast_conversion_blockers._note: The page still speaks as an operating installer. It must stop doing that before it runs as a lead-gen site, and none of it is a judgement call to make without the owner.
seacoast_conversion_blockers.warranty: Service card reads 'Five-year parts warranty — Every shutter we sell carries a five-year parts warranty.' There is no longer a business to honour it. This is an unsupported commercial claim and has to go or be rewritten.
seacoast_conversion_blockers.experience: About copy claims 'over twenty years of experience' for a team that no longer operates.
seacoast_conversion_blockers.phone: 386-338-8955 is the former business's number. Leads currently ring it.
seacoast_conversion_blockers.email: nancy@seacoasthurricaneshutters.com routes to a person at the former business.
seacoast_conversion_blockers.mail: The domain carries live MX. DNS cutover preserved it deliberately, so mail still flows to whoever holds that mailbox.

host_only._note: Hosting only. Do not spend time optimising or reporting on these. The shared renderer still emits their structured data, which is accurate and costs nothing.
